# TaskCancelled

`schemas/records/task-cancelled.json`

The payload of task.cancelled/v1 (backlog #226 entry 23): a task in Ready was cancelled, terminally. internal/authority admits it only under its task's id and project, by its event's actor at its time, of a task in Ready, by a live operator or by the supervisor that created the task with no approval in force.
